notes.title: Work on the new update. New map, dragon, forts, mouse control =)
notes.content:
Work on the game stops. I read your reviews and have added many improvements for future updates.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30447093/5c542e827f7126cae43bf116ad20f92cfd850132.jpg[/img]

Short list:
1. A huge map with 25 cities
2. Automatic generation of the landscape and the location of cities
3. The dynamism of the movement
4. Improved the speed of the game
5. Came the FORTS and the dragon
6. 3 enemies on one map(Red, Yellow, Green)
7. Mouse control 

That's not all! Stay tuned!

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kV657kGcCjw&feature=youtu.be]YouTube Video[/url]

notes.title: The types of warriors in Horde Attack
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30447093/42603c42a2b311ced28db6c1009df6c512e8261d.png[/img]

Today I read reviews, where people share their opinion about the game Horde Attack, which I made available for purchase store. Many talk about the small amount of content and the fact that the player controls only riders.

In this article I will show you what types of troops are planned in the game in the next update.

The game will be a minimum of 8 types of soldiers. Which will have different functionality and purpose. Don't want to reveal all the secrets, but not all soldiers will be under the direct control of the player. Some of the soldiers are mercenaries, which you can use to protect the city or perform acts of sabotage. Some soldiers will be required to complete and perform tasks.

I want to mention an important point. In most games there is a common practice of using soldiers. I have a lot of things that I will try to change that. To make it clearer, a small example. In many games tank designed to destroy buildings and walls. In my game it will be other =)

Stay tuned. I hope my game will surprise you with each update and the photos will warm up your interest.
